title: Density of a sign multiset
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $A$ assign to each element of $\Omega$ a sign vector in $\{-1,1\}^n$. The associated probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is the density of the uniform pushforward of $\Omega$ under the map that converts each sign vector to its corresponding binary vector.
